name: CircleColouring
doc:
/-- A colouring of the circle by `ℤ/3`, proper at `60°`: `c` has period `2π` and is locally constant off the
`2π`-periodic set `S`, which has finitely many points in each period, and `c θ ≠ c (θ + π/3)` wherever `θ` and
`θ + π/3` are both off `S`. -/
sig: structure CircleColouring

name: Lift
doc:
/-- A lift of the colouring to `ℤ`: agreeing with `c` mod 3 off `S`, locally constant off `S`, and changing by at
most one across every point. -/

name: lensΛ
sig: def lensΛ (a b : ℝ) : Set ℂ

name: exit_lens
doc:
/-- **FS116-S1-EXIT** at the class its argument reads: with `30° < b < 90°`, `−90° < a < −30°`, a curve with left derivative
`γ' ≠ 0` at `t_e`, inside `Λ` just before `t_e` and on its frontier at `t_e` other than `0`, whose left unit normal `ν` at
`t_e` meets the four distance conditions, exits with `γ(t_e) + ν = e(b)` or `γ(t_e) − ν = e(a)`. -/
sig: theorem exit_lens {a b : ℝ} (hb₁ : π / 6 < b) (hb₂ : b < π / 2) (ha₁ : -(π / 2) < a) (ha₂ : a < -(π / 6)) {γ : ℝ → ℂ} {γ' : ℂ} {te : ℝ} (hγ : HasDerivWithinAt γ γ' (Iic te) te) (hγ' : γ' ≠ 0) (hin : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[<] te, γ t ∈ lensΛ a b) (hexit : γ te ∈ frontier (lensΛ a b)) (hne : γ te ≠ 0) (h3 : dist (γ te + leftNormal γ') (e (b + π / 3)) ≤ 1) (h5 : dist (γ te - leftNormal γ') (e (a - π / 3)) ≤ 1) (h3' : 1 ≤ dist (γ te) (e (b + π / 3))) (h5' : 1 ≤ dist (γ te) (e (a - π / 3))) : γ te + leftNormal γ' = e b ∨ γ te - leftNormal γ' = e a

name: exit_lens_row
doc:
/-- **FS116-S1-EXIT**, the row's form: a `C¹` curve on `[0, t_e]` with nonvanishing velocity, `γ(0) = 0`, `γ(t) ∈ Λ` for
`0 < t < t_e` and `γ(t_e) ∈ ∂Λ \ {0}`, meeting the four conditions at `t_e` with its left unit normal, exits with
`γ(t_e) + ν(t_e) = y_b` or `γ(t_e) − ν(t_e) = y_a`. -/
sig: theorem exit_lens_row {a b : ℝ} (hb₁ : π / 6 < b) (hb₂ : b < π / 2) (ha₁ : -(π / 2) < a) (ha₂ : a < -(π / 6)) {γ : ℝ → ℂ} {te : ℝ} (hte : 0 < te) (hC1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Icc 0 te)) (hreg : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 te, derivWithin γ (Icc 0 te) t ≠ 0) (h0 : γ 0 = 0) (hin : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 te, γ t ∈ lensΛ a b) (hexit : γ te ∈ frontier (lensΛ a b)) (hne : γ te ≠ 0) (h3 : dist (γ te + leftNormal (derivWithin γ (Icc 0 te) te)) (e (b + π / 3)) ≤ 1) (h5 : dist (γ te - leftNormal (derivWithin γ (Icc 0 te) te)) (e (a - π / 3)) ≤ 1) (h3' : 1 ≤ dist (γ te) (e (b + π / 3))) (h5' : 1 ≤ dist (γ te) (e (a - π / 3))) : γ te + leftNormal (derivWithin γ (Icc 0 te) te) = e b ∨ γ te - leftNormal (derivWithin γ (Icc 0 te) te) = e a

name: coneAt
doc:
/-- The cone of `S` at `y`: the angles `β` along which `S` approaches `y`, i.e. the limits of the unit directions
`(z − y)/|z − y|` over points `z ∈ S`, `z ≠ y`, tending to `y`. -/
sig: def coneAt (S : Set ℂ) (y : ℂ) : Set ℝ

name: coneAt_mono
doc: /-- The cone grows with the set. -/
sig: theorem coneAt_mono {S T : Set ℂ} (h : S ⊆ T) (y : ℂ) : coneAt S y ⊆ coneAt T y

name: mem_coneAt_add_two_pi
doc: /-- The cone is `2π`-periodic. -/

name: mem_closure_of_mem_coneAt

name: GermIn

name: germ_mono
doc: /-- A shorter germ lies inside a longer one. -/

name: Arc.InitialPiece
doc:
/-- `B` is an initial piece of the arc `α` leaving the point `y` in the direction `δ`: for a segment, a subsegment
`[y, y + ε e(δ)]`; for a circular arc of positive radius, the points `c + ρ e(φ + σ t)`, `0 ≤ t ≤ ε`, from
`y = c + ρ e(φ)`, turning in the sense `σ = ±1` whose initial direction is `e(δ) = e(φ + σ π/2)`. -/
sig: def Arc.InitialPiece : Arc → ℂ → ℝ → Set ℂ → Prop | .seg a b, y, δ, B => ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ B = segment ℝ y (y + (ε : ℂ) * e δ) ∧ B ⊆ segment ℝ a b | .circ c ρ θ₀ θ₁, y, δ, B => 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ φ ε σ : ℝ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧ 0 < ε ∧ y = c + ρ * e φ ∧ e δ = e (φ + σ * (π / 2)) ∧ B = (fun t : ℝ => c + ρ * e (φ + σ * t)) '' Icc 0 ε ∧ (fun t : ℝ => φ + σ * t) '' Icc 0 ε ⊆ Icc θ₀ θ₁

sig: theorem quadRing_mem_interiorPts {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ < 2) (hre : z.re ≠ 0) (him : z.im ≠ 0) (hn : ‖z‖ ≠ 1) : z ∈ quadRing.interiorPts

name: quadRing_ringPt_mem_Γ

name: quadRing_col_first

circle and `2` outside. -/
sig: theorem quadRing_col_first {θ t : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo 0 (π / 2)) (ht : 0 < t) : quadRing.col (t * e θ) = if 1 < t then 2 else 0

name: eventually_first_quadrant
doc: /-- Near a point of the open first quadrant every point has positive real and imaginary parts. -/

name: quadRing_first_mem_region
doc:
/-- A point `t e(θ)` of the open first quadrant, `0 < t < 2`, `t ≠ 1`, lies in `quadRing`'s colour class of
colour `0` inside the circle and `2` outside. -/
sig: theorem quadRing_first_mem_region {θ t : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo 0 (π / 2)) (ht0 : 0 < t) (ht2 : t < 2) (ht1 : t ≠ 1) : (t : ℂ) * e θ ∈ quadRing.region (if 1 < t then 2 else 0)

name: dist_scale_e

name: quadRing_isRingArc

doc: /-- `r(π/4)` lies on an arc of `Γ` on `quadRing`'s ring, and `r(0)` on a closed (Q) arc (its end). -/
sig: example : quadRing.OnRingArc 0 (ringPt 0 (π / 4)) ∧ quadRing.OnQArc 0 (ringPt 0 0)

name: upperDensityAt_empty

doc:

sig: example (w : ℂ) : (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ (0 : Fin 2)).essColours w = {0} ∧ ¬ (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ (0 : Fin 2)).IsEssBoundary w ∧ (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ (0 : Fin 2)).SaturatedAt w

name: const_ball_isTile_iff
doc: /-- The tiles of the one-colour map of a disc: the disc alone. -/
sig: theorem const_ball_isTile_iff {T : Set ℂ} (j : Fin 2) : (ArcMap.const (ball (0 : ℂ) 2) isOpen_ball j).IsTile T ↔ T = ball 0 2

doc: /-- The disc is a tile of colour `j` of the one-colour map of the disc. -/

doc:
/-- The whole-tile restriction of the one-colour map of `B(0, 2)` about `0` keeps the disc: its one tile meets

sig: example (j : Fin 2) : (ArcMap.const (ball (0 : ℂ) 2) isOpen_ball j).wholeDom 0 1 = ball 0 2

doc: /-- The segment `[0, 1]` is an initial piece of the segment `[0, 2]` leaving `0` in the direction `0`. -/
sig: example : (Arc.seg 0 2).InitialPiece 0 0 (segment ℝ 0 1)

name: angleIcc
doc: /-- The closed angular interval `[a, b]`, repeated with period `2π`. -/
sig: def angleIcc (a b : ℝ) : Set ℝ

name: Icc_subset_angleIcc
doc: /-- `[a, b]` lies in its angular interval. -/
sig: theorem Icc_subset_angleIcc (a b : ℝ) : Icc a b ⊆ angleIcc a b

name: Ioo_subset_angleIoo
doc: /-- `(a, b)` lies in its angular interval. -/

sig: example : -(π / 2) ∉ angleIoo 0 π

name: Arc.finite_inter_sphere_or_eq_circ
doc:
/-- A nondegenerate arc meets the unit circle `ω(p)` in finitely many points, unless it is an arc of `ω(p)` itself (a
line or a different circle meets `ω(p)` in at most two points). -/
sig: theorem Arc.finite_inter_sphere_or_eq_circ (a : Arc) (ha : a.Nondegenerate) (p : ℂ) : (a.carrier ∩ sphere p 1).Finite ∨ ∃ θ₀ θ₁, a = .circ p 1 θ₀ θ₁

name: covers_one_iff
doc:
/-- A fragment covers `B̄(p, 1)` exactly when it covers a closed disc of radius above `1` about `p`: the domain is open and
the disc compact. Every row's "on a closed disc of radius above 1 about `p`" is stated as `F.Covers p 1`. -/
sig: theorem covers_one_iff (p : ℂ) : F.Covers p 1 ↔ ∃ R, 1 < R ∧ F.Covers p R

name: finite_ringΓ_off_ringArc
doc:
/-- On a covered ring, the points of `Γ` that lie on no arc of `Γ` on `ω(p)` are finitely many: the ring is compact, each
of its points has a neighbourhood meeting finitely many arcs, and each arc not on `ω(p)` meets `ω(p)` in finitely many
points (`Arc.finite_inter_sphere_or_eq_circ`). -/
sig: theorem finite_ringΓ_off_ringArc {p : ℂ} (hp : F.Covers p 1) : ((F.Γ ∩ sphere p 1) \ {x | F.OnRingArc p x}).Finite

name: dense_interiorPts
doc: /-- `Γ` has empty interior: every point of the domain is a limit of interior points. -/
sig: theorem dense_interiorPts : F.dom ⊆ closure F.interiorPts

name: exists_mem_coloursAt
doc: /-- Every point of the domain carries a colour. -/
sig: theorem exists_mem_coloursAt {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ F.dom) : ∃ c, c ∈ F.coloursAt x

name: finite_tiles_near
doc:
/-- **Finitely many tiles meet a small disc about any point of the domain**: near `x` only the arcs through `x` remain,
each with at most two branches at `x`; for small `r` the branches are disjoint off `x` and cut `B(x, r)` into at most as
many curvilinear sectors as there are branches, each connected. -/
sig: theorem finite_tiles_near {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ F.dom) : ∃ r > 0, {T | F.IsTile T ∧ (T ∩ ball x r).Nonempty}.Finite

name: mem_coloursAt_iff_exists_tileOf
doc:
/-- The colours at a point of the domain are the colours of the tiles whose closure holds it (the rows' `P_cl`, read
tile by tile). -/
sig: theorem mem_coloursAt_iff_exists_tileOf {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ F.dom) {c : Fin k} : c ∈ F.coloursAt x ↔ ∃ T, F.TileOf c T ∧ x ∈ closure T

name: coneAt_region_eq_biUnion
doc:
/-- At a point of the domain, the cone of a colour class is the union of the cones of its tiles whose closure holds the
point: "the cone of a tile of colour `c`" and "the cone of the class of `c`" agree. -/
sig: theorem coneAt_region_eq_biUnion {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ F.dom) (c : Fin k) : coneAt (F.region c) x = ⋃ T ∈ {T | F.TileOf c T ∧ x ∈ closure T}, coneAt T x

name: exists_mem_coneAt_region
doc:
/-- At a point of the domain every direction lies in the cone of some colour (pigeonhole over the finitely many colours,
on interior points near the ray). -/
sig: theorem exists_mem_coneAt_region {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ F.dom) (β : ℝ) : ∃ c, β ∈ coneAt (F.region c) x

name: germ_dichotomy
doc:
/-- **The germ dichotomy**: at a ring point `r(θ)` of the domain, the germ of `ω(p)` on either side lies in one colour
class, or on an arc of `Γ` on `ω(p)` with constant sides (the strip beside a short germ avoids every other arc, which
meets `ω(p)` in finitely many points). -/
sig: theorem germ_dichotomy {p : ℂ} {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ringPt p θ ∈ F.dom) (s : Side) : (∃ c, GermIn p θ s (F.region c)) ∨ ∃ θ₁ θ₂ c c', F.IsRingArc p θ₁ θ₂ c c' ∧ GermIn p θ s (ringArc p θ₁ θ₂)

name: Simple.coneAt_eq_angleIcc
doc:
/-- **In a simple map each tile's cone at a point of its closure is one closed angular interval** (possibly a single
direction, a cusp, or every direction): near the point the tile's boundary is a Jordan curve with exactly two branches,
each a segment or a circular arc, and the tile is the sector between them. -/
sig: theorem Simple.coneAt_eq_angleIcc (hS : F.Simple) {T : Set ℂ} (hT : F.IsTile T) {x : ℂ} (hxd : x ∈ F.dom) (hx : x ∈ closure T) : ∃ β₁ β₂, β₁ ≤ β₂ ∧ β₂ ≤ β₁ + 2 * π ∧ coneAt T x = angleIcc β₁ β₂

name: exists_lift
doc: /-- Every circle colouring has a lift (integrate the steps `±1` across the finitely many change points of a period). -/
sig: theorem exists_lift : Nonempty C.Lift

name: PairPos
doc: /-- The positions carrying two change points `60°` apart: `θ` with `θ + 60°j, θ + 60°(j + 1) ∈ S` for some `j < 6`. -/
sig: def PairPos (θ : ℝ) : Prop

name: ringband_i
sig: theorem ringband_i {θ : ℝ} (hθ : C.Good θ) : 3 * C.h θ = C.hSum θ ∧ C.hSum θ = 6 - 2 * (L.n₂ θ : ℤ) ∧ C.h θ ∈ ({-2, 0, 2} : Set ℤ)

name: ringband_ii
doc: /-- **FS129-SR1-RINGBAND** (ii): `W = m₀ + … + m₅ + 3 − h/2` at every good `θ` (and `3` divides `f(θ + 2π) − f(θ)`). -/
sig: theorem ringband_ii {θ : ℝ} (hθ : C.Good θ) : 3 ∣ L.f (θ + 2 * π) - L.f θ ∧ L.W θ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range 6, L.m j θ + 3 - C.h θ / 2

name: W_eq
doc: /-- **FS129-SR1-RINGBAND**, the row's "put `W = (c̃(θ + 360°) − c̃(θ))/3`": the winding is the same at every `θ` off `S`. -/
sig: theorem W_eq {θ θ' : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∉ C.S) (hθ' : θ' ∉ C.S) : L.W θ = L.W θ'

name: ringband_iii
doc: /-- **FS129-SR1-RINGBAND** (iii): `h` changes across `θ₀` only if `S` holds two points `θ₀ + 60°j` and `θ₀ + 60°(j + 1)`. -/
sig: theorem ringband_iii {θ₀ : ℝ} (h0 : ¬ C.PairPos θ₀) : ∃ ε > 0, ∀ θ θ', |θ - θ₀| < ε → |θ' - θ₀| < ε → C.Good θ → C.Good θ' → C.h θ = C.h θ'

name: ringband_iv
doc:
/-- **FS129-SR1-RINGBAND** (iv): with no swap point, all `m_j(θ)` equal one integer `M`, `W` is `6M + 2`, `6M + 3` or `6M + 4`,
and `W = 6M + 3` unless `S` is invariant under the rotation by `60°`. -/
sig: theorem ringband_iv (hns : ∀ x, ¬ C.IsSwap x) : ∃ M : ℤ, (∀ θ, C.Good θ → ∀ j < 6, L.m j θ = M) ∧ ∀ θ, C.Good θ → (L.W θ = 6 * M + 2 ∨ L.W θ = 6 * M + 3 ∨ L.W θ = 6 * M + 4) ∧ ((¬ ∀ x, x ∈ C.S ↔ x + π / 3 ∈ C.S) → L.W θ = 6 * M + 3)

name: ringband_v
doc:
/-- **FS129-SR1-RINGBAND** (v): with no two points of `S` `60°` apart, `h = 0` at every good `θ` and `W = 6M + 3` (`M` the
common value of the `m_j`). -/
sig: theorem ringband_v (hno : ∀ x ∈ C.S, x + π / 3 ∉ C.S) : ∃ M : ℤ, (∀ θ, C.Good θ → ∀ j < 6, L.m j θ = M) ∧ ∀ θ, C.Good θ → C.h θ = 0 ∧ L.W θ = 6 * M + 3

name: ringband_vi_periodic
doc: /-- **FS129-SR1-RINGBAND** (vi), from FS129-OA1-RINGWIND (caution C137), first clause: `h` has period `60°`. -/
sig: theorem ringband_vi_periodic {θ : ℝ} (hθ : C.Good θ) : C.h (θ + π / 3) = C.h θ

name: ringband_vi_noJump
doc:
/-- **FS129-SR1-RINGBAND** (vi), second clause: a hexagon position that is the only one in its period with two change points
`60°` apart carries no jump of `h` (the jumps over one period sum to zero). -/
sig: theorem ringband_vi_noJump {θ₀ : ℝ} (honly : ∀ x, C.PairPos x → ∃ m : ℤ, x = θ₀ + m * (π / 3)) : ∃ ε > 0, ∀ θ θ', |θ - θ₀| < ε → |θ' - θ₀| < ε → C.Good θ → C.Good θ' → C.h θ = C.h θ'

name: exists_swap_of_abs_W_le_one
doc: /-- **FS110-N2-RING**, on the circle: `|W| ≤ 1` forces a swap point. -/
sig: theorem exists_swap_of_abs_W_le_one {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∉ C.S) (hW : |L.W θ| ≤ 1) : ∃ x, C.IsSwap x

name: W_mod_six
doc: /-- **FS110-Y3-GP**, on the circle: with no two change points `60°` apart, `W ≡ 3 (mod 6)`. -/
sig: theorem W_mod_six (hno : ∀ x ∈ C.S, x + π / 3 ∉ C.S) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∉ C.S) : L.W θ % 6 = 3

name: exists_pair_of_abs_W_le_two
doc: /-- **FS110-Y3-GP**, on the circle: `|W| ≤ 2` needs two change points `60°` apart. -/
sig: theorem exists_pair_of_abs_W_le_two {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∉ C.S) (hW : |L.W θ| ≤ 2) : ∃ x ∈ C.S, x + π / 3 ∈ C.S

name: ring_finite_S
doc:
/-- The change set of the ring: `S = {θ | r(θ) ∈ Γ}`, finite per period on a covered ring carrying no arc of `Γ`
(`finite_ringΓ_off_ringArc`). -/
sig: theorem ring_finite_S {p : ℂ} (hp : F.Covers p 1) (hno : ∀ x, ¬ F.OnRingArc p x) : ({θ | ringPt p θ ∈ F.Γ} ∩ Ico 0 (2 * π)).Finite

name: ring_locallyConstant
doc: /-- The ring colouring is locally constant off `S`: a ring point off `Γ` on a covered ring is an interior point. -/
sig: theorem ring_locallyConstant {p : ℂ} (hp : F.Covers p 1) (g : Fin k → ZMod 3) : ∀ θ ∉ {θ | ringPt p θ ∈ F.Γ}, ∀ᶠ θ' in 𝓝 θ, g (F.col (ringPt p θ')) = g (F.col (ringPt p θ))

name: ring_proper
doc:
/-- The ring colouring is proper at `60°`: two ring points off `Γ` `60°` apart are at distance `1`, so have different colours
(validity), both absent at `p` (FS116-V4-TWIST), which `g` keeps apart. -/
sig: theorem ring_proper (hF : F.Valid) {p : ℂ} (hp : F.Covers p 1) {g : Fin k → ZMod 3} (hg : Set.InjOn g (F.coloursAt p)ᶜ) : ∀ θ, θ ∉ {θ | ringPt p θ ∈ F.Γ} → θ + π / 3 ∉ {θ | ringPt p θ ∈ F.Γ} → g (F.col (ringPt p θ)) ≠ g (F.col (ringPt p (θ + π / 3)))

name: ringCircleColouring
doc:
/-- **The map bridge** (FS110-N2-RING's setting): the ring of a point `p` of a valid map covering `B̄(p, 1)`, whose ring carries
no arc of `Γ`, coloured through `g : Fin k → ZMod 3` injective on the colours absent at `p`, is a circle colouring with change
set `{θ | r(θ) ∈ Γ}`. (At a three-colour vertex of a six-coloured map, `g` is any bijection of the three absent colours onto
`ℤ/3`.) -/
sig: noncomputable def ringCircleColouring (hF : F.Valid) {p : ℂ} (hp : F.Covers p 1) (hno : ∀ x, ¬ F.OnRingArc p x) (g : Fin k → ZMod 3) (hg : Set.InjOn g (F.coloursAt p)ᶜ) : CircleColouring

name: exists_swap_of_ring
doc:
/-- **FS110-N2-RING**, on the map: at a point whose ring carries no arc of `Γ`, the ring colouring's winding satisfies
`|W| ≤ 1` only if the ring has a swap point. -/
sig: theorem exists_swap_of_ring (hF : F.Valid) {p : ℂ} (hp : F.Covers p 1) (hno : ∀ x, ¬ F.OnRingArc p x) (g : Fin k → ZMod 3) (hg : Set.InjOn g (F.coloursAt p)ᶜ) (L : (ringCircleColouring hF hp hno g hg).Lift) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : ringPt p θ ∉ F.Γ) (hW : |L.W θ| ≤ 1) : ∃ x, (ringCircleColouring hF hp hno g hg).IsSwap x

name: not_germIn_closure_rotate
doc:
/-- **FS116-V4-TWIST**, first clause (class form; the covering hypothesis is idle): no colour class has in its closure both
a germ `g` of `ω(p)` and its rotation `σg` by `60°` about `p` (σ⁻¹`g` is the same statement at `θ − π/3`). -/
sig: theorem not_germIn_closure_rotate (hF : F.Valid) (p : ℂ) (θ : ℝ) (s : Side) (c : Fin k) : ¬ (GermIn p θ s (closure (F.region c)) ∧ GermIn p (θ + π / 3) s (closure (F.region c)))

name: not_mem_coloursAt_of_mem_sphere
doc:
/-- **FS116-V4-TWIST**, second clause ("when `p` is a vertex" is idle): a point of `ω(p)` inside a tile of colour `c` has `c`
absent at `p`. -/
sig: theorem not_mem_coloursAt_of_mem_sphere (hF : F.Valid) {p z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ sphere p 1) {c : Fin k} (hzc : z ∈ F.region c) : c ∉ F.coloursAt p

name: ringD
doc:
/-- The set `D` of FS116-N1-TWIST-D: the points of `ω(p)` in the closure of a tile of one of `p`'s colours (class form; equal
to the tile form on a covered ring, `mem_coloursAt_iff_exists_tileOf`). -/
sig: def ringD (F : ArcMap k) (p : ℂ) : Set ℂ

name: isClosed_ringD
doc: /-- **FS116-N1-TWIST-D**, `D` is closed. -/
sig: theorem isClosed_ringD (p : ℂ) : IsClosed (F.ringD p)

name: ringD_subset_Γ
doc: /-- **FS116-N1-TWIST-D** ("vertex" idle; any point `p`): `D` lies in `Γ`. -/
sig: theorem ringD_subset_Γ (hF : F.Valid) {p : ℂ} (hp : F.Covers p 1) : F.ringD p ⊆ F.Γ

name: finite_ringD_off_ringArc
doc: /-- **FS116-N1-TWIST-D**: `D` lies in the union of the arcs of `Γ` on `ω(p)` and finitely many points. -/
sig: theorem finite_ringD_off_ringArc (hF : F.Valid) {p : ℂ} (hp : F.Covers p 1) : (F.ringD p \ {x | F.OnRingArc p x}).Finite

name: germR_vMinus
doc:
/-- **FS116-N1-GERM-R**, `v⁻`: if the germ just clockwise of `r(ψ − 60°)` lies in the closure of the class of `c`, the class
approaches `y = r(ψ)` along no direction `β` with `β − ψ ∈ (150°, 330°)`. -/
sig: theorem germR_vMinus (hF : F.Valid) {p : ℂ} {ψ : ℝ} {c : Fin k} (h : GermIn p (ψ - π / 3) .cw (closure (F.region c))) : ∀ β ∈ Ioo (ψ + 5 * π / 6) (ψ + 11 * π / 6), β ∉ coneAt (F.region c) (ringPt p ψ)

name: germR_vPlus
doc: /-- **FS116-N1-GERM-R**, `v⁺`: the germ just counter-clockwise of `r(ψ − 60°)`; the interval `(−30°, 150°)`. -/
sig: theorem germR_vPlus (hF : F.Valid) {p : ℂ} {ψ : ℝ} {c : Fin k} (h : GermIn p (ψ - π / 3) .ccw (closure (F.region c))) : ∀ β ∈ Ioo (ψ - π / 6) (ψ + 5 * π / 6), β ∉ coneAt (F.region c) (ringPt p ψ)

name: germR_uMinus
doc: /-- **FS116-N1-GERM-R**, `u⁻`: the germ just clockwise of `r(ψ + 60°)`; the interval `(−150°, 30°)`. -/
sig: theorem germR_uMinus (hF : F.Valid) {p : ℂ} {ψ : ℝ} {c : Fin k} (h : GermIn p (ψ + π / 3) .cw (closure (F.region c))) : ∀ β ∈ Ioo (ψ - 5 * π / 6) (ψ + π / 6), β ∉ coneAt (F.region c) (ringPt p ψ)

name: germR_uPlus
doc: /-- **FS116-N1-GERM-R**, `u⁺`: the germ just counter-clockwise of `r(ψ + 60°)`; the interval `(30°, 210°)`. -/
sig: theorem germR_uPlus (hF : F.Valid) {p : ℂ} {ψ : ℝ} {c : Fin k} (h : GermIn p (ψ + π / 3) .ccw (closure (F.region c))) : ∀ β ∈ Ioo (ψ + π / 6) (ψ + 7 * π / 6), β ∉ coneAt (F.region c) (ringPt p ψ)

name: germS_absent
doc:
/-- **FS116-N1-GERM-S**, the count: at a change point `y = r(ψ)` of the ring of a vertex `p` of at least four colours with at
most two colours absent, exactly two are absent — `X` (the ring's colour just counter-clockwise of `y`) and `X'` (`X̄`, just
clockwise). At `k = 6`: "`p` has four colours and no more, `X` and `X̄` are the colours absent at `p`". -/
sig: theorem germS_absent (hF : F.Valid) {p : ℂ} (hp : F.Covers p 1) (h4 : 4 ≤ (F.coloursAt p).ncard) (hk : k ≤ (F.coloursAt p).ncard + 2) {ψ : ℝ} {X X' : Fin k} (hy : F.IsChangePoint p ψ X X') : (F.coloursAt p).ncard + 2 = k ∧ (F.coloursAt p)ᶜ = {X, X'}

name: germS_inward
doc:
/-- **FS116-N1-GERM-S** (i): if neither `v⁻` nor `u⁺` lies on a (Q) arc, every direction at `y` in the open `60°` cone about
the direction to `p` lies in the cone of a colour `c` of `p` every tile of `p` of which colour lies in `B̄(y, 1)`. -/
sig: theorem germS_inward (hF : F.Valid) {p : ℂ} (hp : F.Covers p 1) (h4 : 4 ≤ (F.coloursAt p).ncard) (hk : k ≤ (F.coloursAt p).ncard + 2) {ψ : ℝ} {X X' : Fin k} (hy : F.IsChangePoint p ψ X X') (hv : ¬ F.GermOnQ p (ψ - π / 3) .cw) (hu : ¬ F.GermOnQ p (ψ + π / 3) .ccw) : ∀ β ∈ Ioo (ψ + 5 * π / 6) (ψ + 7 * π / 6), ∃ c ∈ F.coloursAt p, β ∈ coneAt (F.region c) (ringPt p ψ) ∧ ∀ A, F.TileOf c A → p ∈ closure A → A ⊆ closedBall (ringPt p ψ) 1

name: germS_outward
doc:
/-- **FS116-N1-GERM-S** (ii): if neither `u⁻` nor `v⁺` lies on a (Q) arc, every direction at `y` in the open `60°` cone about
the direction away from `p` lies in the cone of a tile, not a tile of `p`, of a colour `c` of `p` every tile of `p` of which
colour misses `B(y, 1)`. "A tile, not a tile of `p`" is the part of the class outside `B̄(p, 1)`, which no tile of `p` meets
(`IsTile.subset_ball`);
sig: theorem germS_outward (hF : F.Valid) {p : ℂ} (hp : F.Covers p 1) (h4 : 4 ≤ (F.coloursAt p).ncard) (hk : k ≤ (F.coloursAt p).ncard + 2) {ψ : ℝ} {X X' : Fin k} (hy : F.IsChangePoint p ψ X X') (hu : ¬ F.GermOnQ p (ψ + π / 3) .cw) (hv : ¬ F.GermOnQ p (ψ - π / 3) .ccw) : ∀ β ∈ Ioo (ψ - π / 6) (ψ + π / 6), ∃ c ∈ F.coloursAt p, β ∈ coneAt (F.region c \ closedBall p 1) (ringPt p ψ) ∧ ∀ A, F.TileOf c A → p ∈ closure A → Disjoint A (ball (ringPt p ψ) 1)

name: germS_four
doc:

colours. -/

name: ringQPrimeS
doc:

name: lebesgue_covering_square
doc:
/-- **Lebesgue's covering theorem for the square** (`n = 2`): if a closed square is covered by finitely many closed sets none of
which meets two opposite sides, some point of the square lies in three of them. Hurewicz–Wallman, *Dimension Theory* (1941), Thm IV 2
(the `n`-cube, `n + 1` sets); SB's step 6 (`plans/FS106-SB-verification.md` § 2.5). **An outside theorem, its disposition owed**
(`plans/
sig: theorem lebesgue_covering_square {m : ℕ} (c : ℂ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (F : Fin m → Set ℂ) (hF : ∀ i, IsClosed (F i)) (hcov : closedSquare c s ⊆ ⋃ i, F i) (hLR : ∀ i, ¬ ((∃ z ∈ F i ∩ closedSquare c s, z.re = c.re) ∧ ∃ z ∈ F i ∩ closedSquare c s, z.re = c.re + s)) (hBT : ∀ i, ¬ ((∃ z ∈ F i ∩ closedSquare c s, z.im = c.im) ∧ ∃ z ∈ F i ∩ closedSquare c s, z.im = c.im + s)) : ∃ z ∈ closedSquare c s, ∃ i j l : Fin m, i ≠ j ∧ i ≠ l ∧ j ≠ l ∧ z ∈ F i ∧ z ∈ F j ∧ z ∈ F l

name: exists_three_le_multicolour
doc:

name: pair_i
doc:
/-- **FS112-N3-PAIRS** (i), N3-I (CB's (i) never fails): for cubic trichromatic `u₁`, `u₂` and a unit pair `x ∈ ω(u₁)`,
`y ∈ ω(u₂)`, the pseudo-colours `c′(x) = c′(y) = {a}` are impossible (no transversality hypothesis; `u₁ = u₂` allowed). -/
sig: theorem pair_i (hF : F.Valid) {u₁ u₂ x y : ℂ} (h₁ : F.IsCubicTrichromatic u₁) (h₂ : F.IsCubicTrichromatic u₂) (hc₁ : F.Covers u₁ 1) (hc₂ : F.Covers u₂ 1) (hx : dist x u₁ = 1) (hy : dist y u₂ = 1) (hxy : dist x y = 1) {a : Fin k} (hax : F.pseudoColours u₁ x = {a}) (hay : F.pseudoColours u₂ y = {a}) : False

name: pair_ii
doc:

to `ω(u₁)` at `x` (`y ≠ u₁`, `|y − u₁| ≠ 2`), `x` carries at least four colours or `y` is the centre of a both-kind unit arc. -/

name: fail_leavingCentre

name: fail_colours
doc:

inner colours of the arcs of `ω(q)` leaving `u`, those occurring outside among their outer colours, and each side carries at least one

in-t

doc:
/-- **The allowed cone `D_c(v)`** (FS110-N3-CONF): the vectors `d` with `d·(w − v) ≥ 0` at every in-type contact `w` and
`d·(w − v) ≤ 0` at every out-type contact. A direction `β` is allowed when `e β` lies in it; `interior` is taken in `ℂ`. -/
sig: def allowedCone (v : ℂ) (c : Fin k) : Set ℂ

name: MergeAvailable
doc:
/-- **MERGE is available at `v`** (FS110-W-MERGE's hypothesis): some colour with at least two sectors at `v` has an allowed
cone with non-empty interior. -/
sig: def MergeAvailable (v : ℂ) : Prop

name: RayAvailable
doc: /-- **MERGE-RAY is available at `v`** (FS110-N4-SHAVE's N4-RAY): one colour has two horns along one ray. -/
sig: def RayAvailable (v : ℂ) : Prop

name: ShaveAvailable
doc:
/-- **SHAVE is available at `v`** (FS110-N4-SHAVE): some horn, with flank colours `g` above and `h` below, splits along an arc
tangent to its axis, of a curvature `σ` between its bounding curvatures, into a lower part clear for `h` and an upper part
clear for `g` — so its tip may be recoloured by its two flanks. -/
sig: def ShaveAvailable (v : ℂ) : Prop

name: DoublyShadowed
doc:
/-- **A doubly shadowed horn** (FS110-N4-SHAVE, `σ_h < σ_g`): a band of the horn between two tangent arcs lies, near `v`, in
the shadow of both flank colours' classes. -/
sig: def DoublyShadowed (v : ℂ) (α κ₁ κ₂ : ℝ) (g h : Fin k) : Prop

name: TerminalOn
doc:
/-- **Terminal on `U`**: no MERGE, MERGE-RAY or SHAVE is available at any point of `U` (a fragment's local form; FS112-BOWTIE
is terminal on a neighbourhood of its three named points). -/
sig: def TerminalOn (U : Set ℂ) : Prop

name: Terminal
doc: /-- **A terminal map** (FS110-N4-PROP): no MERGE, MERGE-RAY or SHAVE is available at any point. -/
sig: def Terminal : Prop

name: IsStuck
doc:
/-- **A stuck vertex** (FS110-N4-STUCK's hypothesis): no move is available at `v`, and some colour has at least two sectors
there. -/
sig: def IsStuck (v : ℂ) : Prop

name: InContact
doc: /-- **An in-contact** (FS-112): an arc of `Γ` on `ω(p)` with constant sides whose inner colour is carried at its centre. -/
sig: def InContact (p : ℂ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) : Prop

name: OutContact
doc: /-- **An out-contact**: the outer colour is carried at the centre. -/
sig: def OutContact (p : ℂ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) : Prop

name: BothKind
doc: /-- **A both-kind arc**: both side colours are carried at the centre. -/
sig: def BothKind (p : ℂ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) : Prop

name: Inert
doc: /-- **An inert arc**: neither side colour is carried at the centre. -/
sig: def Inert (p : ℂ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) : Prop

name: radiusTwoArc
doc: /-- `R₂(ᾱ)`: the arc of the circle of radius `2` about `p` over the angles of `ᾱ = r([θ₁, θ₂])`. -/
sig: noncomputable def radiusTwoArc (p : ℂ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) : Set ℂ

name: IsR2Arc
doc:
/-- **An (R2) arc** (FS-112's header): its centre carries the outer side colour and not the inner, and the inner colour's
class has the whole radius-2 arc `R₂(ᾱ)` in its closure. -/
sig: def IsR2Arc (p : ℂ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) : Prop

name: Condition5
doc:
/-- **Condition 5** (`[SokolovVoronov2025]`: "any boundary intersects with a circle of unit radius at a finite set of
points"), read on the arcs inside the domain. -/
sig: def Condition5 : Prop

name: Condition6
doc:
/-- **Condition 6** (`[SokolovVoronov2025]`: "There are no trichromatic vertices of degree greater than 3"), read on an arc map: a
point carrying exactly three colours has degree at most `3` (its degree is its number of sectors, `HasDegree`). FS106-TS-T's last
clause (`Plane/SVMap`). -/
sig: def Condition6 : Prop

name: InMK
doc:
/-- **`𝓜_K`** (FS-107, without periodicity, as for the limit object): circular arcs of radius at least `1/K`, and at most `K`
arcs meeting the domain inside any unit disc. -/
sig: def InMK (K : ℕ) : Prop

name: AgreesOff
doc:
/-- **`F'` agrees with `F` off `U`**: the same domain, and outside `U` the same interior points with the same colours. Every
local move of the wave (W-MERGE, MERGE-RAY, SHAVE, the whole-arc bends) produces a map agreeing with the old one off a small
set; off the closure of that set the two maps have the same regions, tiles and colours at every point. -/
sig: def AgreesOff (F' : ArcMap k) (U : Set ℂ) : Prop

name: RingArcsWithin
doc:
/-- **`F` creates no unit arc over `G`**: every point of an arc of `Γ` on a unit circle `ω(p)` in `F` lies on such an arc of
`G` with the same centre (FS112-WALK's reading of "Condition 5 kept": "no unit arc created"). Presentation-free: it reads
`Γ`, never `F.arcs`, as wave 3's `OnRingArc` does; with `G.Condition5` it gives `F.Condition5` back. -/
sig: def RingArcsWithin (G : ArcMap k) : Prop

name: IsCoveringPair
doc:
/-- **A covering pair** `(u, y)` (FS-110's claim list § 0 as corrected at its close, § 9 item 1: the union sense): the colours
carried at `u` and at `y` together are all the colours. Disjointness is not part of it. -/
sig: def IsCoveringPair (u y : ℂ) : Prop

doc: /-- `frameX` reads the coordinate along `e α`: at `α = 0` it is the real part of `z − v`. -/
sig: example : frameX 0 0 3 = 3

doc: /-- `frameY` reads the coordinate along `n`: at `α = 0` it is the imaginary part of `z − v`. -/
sig: example : frameY 0 0 I = 1

doc: /-- `ω(N)` is the arc of upward curvature `1`: the point `v + 2n` (frame `(0, 2)`) lies on it. -/
sig: example : tanHeight 1 0 2 = 0

doc: /-- `ω(S′)` is the arc of upward curvature `−1`: `v − 2n` lies on it, and `v + n` lies above it. -/
sig: example : tanHeight (-1) 0 (-2) = 0 ∧ 0 < tanHeight (-1) 0 1

doc: /-- A point of the horn between the curvatures `−1` and `1` along `e 0` at the origin. -/
sig: example : (1 / 4 : ℂ) ∈ hornSet 0 0 (-1) 1 1

doc:
/-- **Adversary**: the horn is open at its lower arc — `1/4` (on the axis, the arc of curvature `0`) is not in the horn
between `0` and `1`. -/
sig: example : (1 / 4 : ℂ) ∉ hornSet 0 0 0 1 1

doc: /-- `curvDown` and `curvUp` are inverse at `1/2`: `f(1) = 1/2` and `f̃(1/2) = 1`. -/
sig: example : curvDown 1 = 1 / 2 ∧ curvUp (1 / 2) = 1

doc: /-- The shadow of a point is its unit circle: `1 ∈ shadow {0}`, **adversary** `1/2 ∉ shadow {0}`. -/
sig: example : (1 : ℂ) ∈ shadow {0} ∧ (1 / 2 : ℂ) ∉ shadow {0}

name: const_isSector_ball
doc: /-- The one-colour disc `B(0, 1)` has the single sector `B(0, 1/2)` at `0` at radius `1/2` (an inhabitant of `IsSector`). -/
sig: theorem const_isSector_ball (j : Fin 2) : (ArcMap.const (ball (0 : ℂ) 1) isOpen_ball j).IsSector 0 (1 / 2) (ball 0 (1 / 2))

name: const_not_isSector_far
doc:
/-- **Adversary**: a set whose closure misses `v` is no sector at `v` — `B(1/2, 1/8)` is no sector of the one-colour disc at
`0`. -/
sig: theorem const_not_isSector_far (j : Fin 2) : ¬ (ArcMap.const (ball (0 : ℂ) 1) isOpen_ball j).IsSector 0 1 (ball (1 / 2) (1 / 8))

doc: /-- The one-colour map of the plane satisfies Condition 5 and lies in `𝓜_0` (no arcs). -/
sig: example (j : Fin 2) : (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ j).Condition5 ∧ (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ j).InMK 0

doc: /-- The one-colour plane satisfies Condition 6: no point carries three colours. -/
sig: example (j : Fin 2) : (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ j).Condition6

doc:
/-- `IsContact` reads the carried colour and the closure of its class on `ω(v)`: on the one-colour plane, `1` is a contact
of the one colour at `0` (validity is not part of the definition). -/
sig: example (j : Fin 2) : (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ j).IsContact 0 j 1

doc: /-- `AgreesOff` is reflexive: a map agrees with itself off any set. -/
sig: example (j : Fin 2) (U : Set ℂ) : (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ j).AgreesOff (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ j) U

doc: /-- **Adversary**: the one-colour planes of the two colours of `Fin 2` do not agree off `∅` (their colours differ at `0`). -/
sig: example : ¬ (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ (1 : Fin 2)).AgreesOff (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ (0 : Fin 2)) ∅

name: unitArcPlane
doc: /-- A map with one unit arc: the plane, one colour, the upper half of `ω(0)` as its only arc. -/
sig: noncomputable def unitArcPlane : ArcMap 1

doc:
/-- `RingArcsWithin` is reflexive, and **adversary**: the arc of `unitArcPlane` is a unit arc the arc-free plane does not have,
so `unitArcPlane` does not create its unit arcs within the one-colour plane. -/
sig: example : unitArcPlane.RingArcsWithin unitArcPlane ∧ ¬ unitArcPlane.RingArcsWithin (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ 0)

doc: /-- On the one-colour plane with one colour, every pair is a covering pair; with two colours (`Fin 2`), none is. -/
sig: example : (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ (0 : Fin 1)).IsCoveringPair 0 1

doc:
/-- **Adversary**: on the one-colour plane with two colours (`Fin 2`) no pair is a covering pair (the other colour is carried
nowhere). -/
sig: example (x y : ℂ) : ¬ (ArcMap.const univ isOpen_univ (0 : Fin 2)).IsCoveringPair x y

name: farSideAbove
doc:
/-- The far side, near `N`, of an arc tangent to `e α` at `N` with upward curvature `μ`, on the `+a` side: the points of
`B(N, δ)` with positive `a`-coordinate above the arc. -/
sig: def farSideAbove (N : ℂ) (α μ δ : ℝ) : Set ℂ

name: farSideBelow
doc: /-- The mirror: the points of `B(S, δ)` with positive `a`-coordinate below the arc of upward curvature `υ` tangent at `S`. -/
sig: def farSideBelow (S : ℂ) (α υ δ : ℝ) : Set ℂ

name: shadow_farSide_above
doc:
/-- **FS110-N4-SHADOW**, going down: the far side of an arc of upward curvature `μ > −1` tangent to `a` at `N = v + n`
shadows a point `z` near `v` with `(z − v)·a > 0` exactly when `z` lies above the circle through `v` concentric with the arc,
of curvature `f(μ) = μ/(1 + μ)`. -/
sig: theorem shadow_farSide_above (v : ℂ) (α : ℝ) {μ δ : ℝ} (hμ : -1 < μ) (hδ : 0 < δ) : ∃ ε > 0, ∀ z, dist z v < ε → 0 < frameX v α z → (z ∈ shadow (farSideAbove (v + e (α + π / 2)) α μ δ) ↔ TanAbove v α (curvDown μ) z)

name: shadow_farSide_below
doc:
/-- **FS110-N4-SHADOW**, going up (the mirror at `S′ = v − n`): an arc of upward curvature `υ < 1` shadows, from below, exactly
the points below the concentric circle of curvature `f̃(υ) = υ/(1 − υ)`. -/
sig: theorem shadow_farSide_below (v : ℂ) (α : ℝ) {υ δ : ℝ} (hυ : υ < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) : ∃ ε > 0, ∀ z, dist z v < ε → 0 < frameX v α z → (z ∈ shadow (farSideBelow (v - e (α + π / 2)) α υ δ) ↔ TanBelow v α (curvUp υ) z)

name: contact_inType_or_outType
doc: /-- **FS110-N3-CONF**, (i): every contact of a colour `c ∈ P_cl(v)` on `ω(v)` is in-type or out-type, and not both. -/
sig: theorem contact_inType_or_outType (hF : F.Valid) {v w : ℂ} {c : Fin k} (hv : F.Covers v 1) (hw : F.IsContact v c w) : (F.InType v c w ∨ F.OutType v c w) ∧ ¬ (F.InType v c w ∧ F.OutType v c w)

name: coneAt_subset_allowedCone
doc:
/-- **FS110-N3-CONF**, (ii): the directions along which `c`'s class approaches `v` (the union of its sectors' cones) lie in the
allowed cone `D_c(v)`. -/
sig: theorem coneAt_subset_allowedCone (hF : F.Valid) {v : ℂ} {c : Fin k} (hv : F.Covers v 1) {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ∈ coneAt (F.region c) v) : e β ∈ F.allowedCone v c

name: clear_of_subset_interior_allowedCone
doc: /-- **FS110-N3-CONF**, (iii) (N3-CLEAR): a compact set of directions inside the interior of `D_c(v)` is clear for `c` near `v`. -/
sig: theorem clear_of_subset_interior_allowedCone (hF : F.Valid) {v : ℂ} {c : Fin k} (hv : F.Covers v 1) (hc : c ∈ F.coloursAt v) {Λ : Set ℝ} (hΛ : IsCompact Λ) (hΛD : e '' Λ ⊆ interior (F.allowedCone v c)) : ∃ ρ > 0, ∀ β ∈ Λ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < ρ → F.IsClear c (v + (t : ℂ) * e β)

name: lens_dist_lt_one_of_up
doc:
/-- **FS110-N3-CONF**, (iv) (N3-UP, the lens `|p|² ≤ 2p_y`, check C1): near `v`, moving a point in the `+n` direction keeps it
within distance `1` of every point of the lens `B(v, 1) ∩ B̄(N, 1)` it was within `1` of — so a point clear of an in-type tile at
`N` (all of whose distances are below `1`) stays clear. -/
sig: theorem lens_dist_lt_one_of_up (v : ℂ) (α : ℝ) : ∃ r > 0, ∀ z, dist z v < r → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → dist (z + t * e (α + π / 2)) v < r → ∀ p ∈ ball v 1 ∩ closedBall (v + e (α + π / 2)) 1, dist z p < 1 → dist (z + t * e (α + π / 2)) p < 1

name: lune_dist_le_of_up
doc:
/-- **FS110-N3-CONF**, (iv) (N3-UP, the lune `p_y ≤ −1/2`, check C2): moving a point near `v` in the `+n` direction moves it
away from every point of the lune `B̄(S′, 1) ∖ B(v, 1)` — so a point clear of an out-type tile at `S′` (all of whose distances
exceed `1`) stays clear. -/
sig: theorem lune_dist_le_of_up (v : ℂ) (α : ℝ) {z : ℂ} (hz : dist z v < 1 / 2) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) {p : ℂ} (hp : p ∈ closedBall (v - e (α + π / 2)) 1 \ ball v 1) : dist z p ≤ dist (z + t * e (α + π / 2)) p

name: woodallCone
doc:
/-- **FS110-N3-DEG**, the cone with unit arcs allowed: if `int D_c(v)` is empty then for some axis `α` the colour `c` has
out-type contacts at both `v ± n`, and every `c`-sector at `v` is a cusp horn along `±a` with bounding curvatures in
`[−1, 1]`. -/
sig: theorem woodallCone (hF : F.Valid) {v : ℂ} {c : Fin k} (hv : F.Covers v 1) (hc : c ∈ F.coloursAt v) (hD : interior (F.allowedCone v c) = ∅) : ∃ α : ℝ, (F.IsContact v c (v + e (α + π / 2)) ∧ F.OutType v c (v + e (α + π / 2))) ∧ (F.IsContact v c (v - e (α + π / 2)) ∧ F.OutType v c (v - e (α + π / 2))) ∧ ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∀ S ∈ F.sectorsOf v r c, ∃ β ∈ ({α, α + π} : Set ℝ), ∃ κ₁ κ₂, -1 ≤ κ₁ ∧ κ₁ < κ₂ ∧ κ₂ ≤ 1 ∧ S = hornSet v β κ₁ κ₂ r

name: woodallCone_strict
doc: /-- **FS110-N3-DEG** as filed (Condition 5): the bounding curvatures of Woodall's cone lie in the open interval `(−1, 1)`. -/
sig: theorem woodallCone_strict (hF : F.Valid) (h5 : F.Condition5) {v : ℂ} {c : Fin k} (hv : F.Covers v 1) (hc : c ∈ F.coloursAt v) (hD : interior (F.allowedCone v c) = ∅) : ∃ α : ℝ, (F.IsContact v c (v + e (α + π / 2)) ∧ F.OutType v c (v + e (α + π / 2))) ∧ (F.IsContact v c (v - e (α + π / 2)) ∧ F.OutType v c (v - e (α + π / 2))) ∧ ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∀ S ∈ F.sectorsOf v r c, ∃ β ∈ ({α, α + π} : Set ℝ), ∃ κ₁ κ₂, -1 < κ₁ ∧ κ₁ < κ₂ ∧ κ₂ < 1 ∧ S = hornSet v β κ₁ κ₂ r

name: flank_shadows
doc:
/-- **FS110-N4-SHADOW**, N4-FLANK: for a `c`-horn along `a` with curvatures in `(−1, 1)`, upper flank `g` and lower flank `h`
(both `≠ c`), the points of the horn near `v` in the shadow of `g`'s class are exactly those below a tangent circle of some
curvature `σ_g ≤ κ₂`, and those in the shadow of `h`'s class exactly those above one of curvature `σ_h ≥ κ₁` (an absent shadow
is `σ_g = κ₁`, `σ_h = κ
sig: theorem flank_shadows (hF : F.Valid) (h5 : F.Condition5) {v : ℂ} (hv : F.Covers v 1) {α κ₁ κ₂ : ℝ} {c g h : Fin k} (hH : F.IsHorn v α κ₁ κ₂ c) (h1 : -1 < κ₁) (h2 : κ₂ < 1) (hg : F.IsFlankAbove v α κ₂ g) (hh : F.IsFlankBelow v α κ₁ h) (hgc : g ≠ c) (hhc : h ≠ c) : ∃ σg σh, κ₁ ≤ σg ∧ σg ≤ κ₂ ∧ κ₁ ≤ σh ∧ σh ≤ κ₂ ∧ ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∀ z ∈ hornSet v α κ₁ κ₂ r, (z ∈ shadow (F.region g) ↔ TanBelow v α σg z) ∧ (z ∈ shadow (F.region h) ↔ TanAbove v α σh z)

name: shaveAvailable_of_not_doublyShadowed
doc:
/-- **FS110-N4-SHAVE**, the criterion: a horn with curvatures in `(−1, 1)` that is not doubly shadowed by its flanks can be
shaved (SHAVE is available at `v`). -/
sig: theorem shaveAvailable_of_not_doublyShadowed (hF : F.Valid) (h5 : F.Condition5) {v : ℂ} (hv : F.Covers v 1) {α κ₁ κ₂ : ℝ} {c g h : Fin k} (hH : F.IsHorn v α κ₁ κ₂ c) (h1 : -1 < κ₁) (h2 : κ₂ < 1) (hg : F.IsFlankAbove v α κ₂ g) (hh : F.IsFlankBelow v α κ₁ h) (hgc : g ≠ c) (hhc : h ≠ c) (hnot : ¬ F.DoublyShadowed v α κ₁ κ₂ g h) : F.ShaveAvailable v

name: exists_shave
doc:
/-- **FS110-N4-SHAVE**, the move: where SHAVE is available at `v` for a colour `c` with `n ≥ 1` sectors, recolouring the horn's
tip gives a valid map, agreeing with `F` off a small disc about `v` and creating no unit arc (Condition 5 kept when `F` has it),
in which `c` has `n − 1` sectors at `v`, no colour is added at `v`, and the new points on the disc's rim carry at most three
colours. Unit arcs
sig: theorem exists_shave (hF : F.Valid) {v : ℂ} (hv : F.Covers v 1) {α κ₁ κ₂ σ : ℝ} {c g h : Fin k} {n : ℕ} (hn : F.HasSectors v c (n + 1)) (hH : F.IsHorn v α κ₁ κ₂ c) (h1 : -1 ≤ κ₁) (h2 : κ₂ ≤ 1) (hg : F.IsFlankAbove v α κ₂ g) (hh : F.IsFlankBelow v α κ₁ h) (hσ₁ : κ₁ ≤ σ) (hσ₂ : σ ≤ κ₂) (hclear : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∀ z ∈ hornSet v α κ₁ κ₂ r, (TanAbove v α σ z → F.IsClear g z) ∧ (¬ TanAbove v α σ z → F.IsClear h z)) : ∃ ρ > 0, ∃ F' : ArcMap k, F'.Valid ∧ F'.AgreesOff F (closedBall v ρ) ∧ F'.RingArcsWithin F ∧ (F.Condition5 → F'.Condition5) ∧ F'.HasSectors v c n ∧ F'.coloursAt v ⊆ F.coloursAt v ∧ ∀ x ∈ sphere v ρ, (F'.coloursAt x).ncard ≤ 3

name: exists_rayMerge
doc:
/-- **FS110-N4-SHAVE**, N4-RAY: two `c`-horns along one ray merge — the region between them is `c`-clear near `v`, and
recolouring it gives a valid map, agreeing with `F` off a small disc about `v` and creating no unit arc, in which `c` has one
sector fewer at `v`. Unit arcs are allowed and the outer bounds may be `±1` (FS112-WALK W3: the region between the horns is bounded
by their inner arcs, of
sig: theorem exists_rayMerge (hF : F.Valid) {v : ℂ} (hv : F.Covers v 1) {α κ₁ κ₂ κ₃ κ₄ : ℝ} {c : Fin k} {n : ℕ} (hn : F.HasSectors v c (n + 1)) (h23 : κ₂ < κ₃) (hH : F.IsHorn v α κ₁ κ₂ c) (hH' : F.IsHorn v α κ₃ κ₄ c) (h1 : -1 ≤ κ₁) (h4 : κ₄ ≤ 1) : (∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∀ z ∈ hornSet v α κ₂ κ₃ r, F.IsClear c z) ∧ ∃ ρ > 0, ∃ F' : ArcMap k, F'.Valid ∧ F'.AgreesOff F (closedBall v ρ) ∧ F'.RingArcsWithin F ∧ (F.Condition5 → F'.Condition5) ∧ F'.HasSectors v c n ∧ F'.coloursAt v ⊆ F.coloursAt v ∧ ∀ x ∈ sphere v ρ, (F'.coloursAt x).ncard ≤ 3

name: exists_merge
doc:
/-- **FS110-W-MERGE**, Woodall's step 3 almost everywhere for curved arcs: if `int D_c(v)` is non-empty and `c` has `n + 1 ≥ 2`
sectors at `v`, recolouring a gap inside `D_c(v)` near `v` gives a valid map, equal to `F` off a small disc about `v`, in which
`c` has `n` sectors at `v`, no point off the disc's rim gains a colour, the new points on the rim carry at most three colours
with none repeated
sig: theorem exists_merge (hF : F.Valid) {v : ℂ} (hv : F.Covers v 1) {c : Fin k} {n : ℕ} (hn1 : 1 ≤ n) (hn : F.HasSectors v c (n + 1)) (hD : (interior (F.allowedCone v c)).Nonempty) : ∃ ρ > 0, ∃ F' : ArcMap k, F'.Valid ∧ F'.AgreesOff F (closedBall v ρ) ∧ F'.RingArcsWithin F ∧ (F.Condition5 → F'.Condition5) ∧ F'.HasSectors v c n ∧ (∀ x ∉ sphere v ρ, F'.coloursAt x ⊆ F.coloursAt x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ sphere v ρ, (F'.coloursAt x).ncard ≤ 3 ∧ ¬ F'.HasRepeatedColour x) ∧ ∀ v' ∉ closedBall v ρ, F'.allowedCone v' c = F.allowedCone v' c

name: stuck_structure
doc:
/-- **FS110-N4-STUCK**, the structure (N4-STUCK (i)–(iv)), stated over "at most three colours at every point of `B̄(v, 1)`"
(the class its argument reads; FS110-NB-4 supplies it under Condition 5): at a stuck vertex the colour `c` with two or more
sectors has exactly two, cusp horns along `±a` with curvatures in `(−1, 1)`; `P_cl(v) = {c, g, h}` and `v` has degree `4`, the
interior points near `v`

name: false_of_changePt_landing
doc:
/-- **Engine A, the contradiction**: a change point `b` of a two-coloured open set `W`, whose unit circle lands (at an angle
`θ ± arccos (ρ/2)` of `ω(u)`) on a collar inside `W`, is impossible — lemma (L) keeps the unit circle about `b` out of `W`. -/
sig: theorem false_of_changePt_landing {A B W : Set ℂ} (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B) (hAu : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y ≠ 1) (hBu : ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ y ∈ B, dist x y ≠ 1) (hW : IsOpen W) (hWAB : W ⊆ closure (A ∪ B)) {u : ℂ} {ρ θ σ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ2 : ρ < 2) (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (hbW : u + (ρ : ℂ) * e θ ∈ W) (hbA : u + (ρ : ℂ) * e θ ∈ closure A) (hbB : u + (ρ : ℂ) * e θ ∈ closure B) {s : Rim} (hland : CollarAt W u s (θ + σ * Real.arccos (ρ / 2))) : False

name: exists_changePt_band
doc:
/-- **Engine B, change points in every band**: a thin collar over an open arc longer than `π/3`, inside `closure (A ∪ B)`, holds a change
point (both classes in its closure) — a unit pair (`exists_unit_pair_collar`) in a connected open two-coloured set. -/
sig: theorem exists_changePt_band {A B : Set ℂ} (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B) (hAu : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y ≠ 1) (hBu : ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ y ∈ B, dist x y ≠ 1) {u : ℂ} {s : Rim} {θ₁ θ₂ h : ℝ} (hlen : π / 3 < θ₂ - θ₁) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (hC : collar u s θ₁ θ₂ h ⊆ closure (A ∪ B)) : ∃ ρ θ : ℝ, θ ∈ Ioo θ₁ θ₂ ∧ ρ ∈ s.radii h ∧ u + (ρ : ℂ) * e θ ∈ closure A ∧ u + (ρ : ℂ) * e θ ∈ closure B

name: false_of_collars_closed
doc:
/-- **Engine C, the closed-arc form** (strengthening of `woodall_step4`): collars on some side about every angle of a closed arc of length
`≥ 2π/3`, and one side carrying them over a closed sub-arc longer than `π/3`, cannot be two-coloured. A change point in a thin band of

sig: theorem false_of_collars_closed {A B : Set ℂ} (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B) (hAu : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y ≠ 1) (hBu : ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ y ∈ B, dist x y ≠ 1) {u : ℂ} {θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ} (hlen : 2 * π / 3 ≤ θ₂ - θ₁) (hcov : ∀ θ ∈ Icc θ₁ θ₂, ∃ s, CollarAt (closure (A ∪ B)) u s θ) (hseed : ∃ (s : Rim) (φ₁ φ₂ : ℝ), θ₁ ≤ φ₁ ∧ φ₂ ≤ θ₂ ∧ π / 3 < φ₂ - φ₁ ∧ ∀ φ ∈ Icc φ₁ φ₂, CollarAt (closure (A ∪ B)) u s φ) : False

name: finite_bad_radii
doc:
/-- **Engine D, the bad radii are finite**: the radii `ρ ∈ (0, 2)` for which twice the landing angle `arccos (ρ/2)` is a difference of two cut
angles mod `2π` are finitely many (`2 arccos (ρ/2) ∈ (0, 2π)` meets each class mod `2π` once, and `arccos` is injective). -/
sig: theorem finite_bad_radii {K : Set ℝ} (hK : K.Finite) : {ρ : ℝ | 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < 2 ∧ ∃ κ ∈ K, ∃ κ' ∈ K, ∃ m : ℤ, 2 * Real.arccos (ρ / 2) = κ - κ' + 2 * π * m}.Finite

name: woodall_step4

/-- **FS106-WO, the step-4 lemma** (`[Woodall1973]` p. 198, as repaired: length **strictly** above `2π/3`): if, on one side `s` of `ω(u)`,
every angle of an open arc of length `> 2π/3` carries a collar inside `closure (A ∪ B)` — `A`, `B` open with no unit pair in either — then
`False`. (A collar about each angle is Woodall's "unit arc of positive thickness" with its thickness `f(θ)` locally bounde
sig: theorem woodall_step4 {A B : Set ℂ} (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B) (hAu : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y ≠ 1) (hBu : ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ y ∈ B, dist x y ≠ 1) {u : ℂ} (s : Rim) {θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ} (hlen : 2 * π / 3 < θ₂ - θ₁) (hW : ∀ θ ∈ Ioo θ₁ θ₂, CollarAt (closure (A ∪ B)) u s θ) : False

doc:
/-- **The step-4 lemma is false at length `2π/3`** — Townsend's counterexample (`[Townsend1979ms]` p. 2; `[Townsend1981]` p. 114): the inner

pair in either part. The strictness in `woodall_step4` cannot be dropped; this is the assertion `[Woodall1973]`

name: townsend_lemma
doc:
/-- **FS106-TW, Townsend's `π/3` lemma** (`[Townsend1979ms]` Thm 1, = `[Townsend1981]`'s lemma, in the form its proof reads): `A`, `B` open with
no unit pair in either; every angle off a finite set `K` of cut angles (and their `2π`-translates) carries a collar, on one side or the other of

sig: theorem townsend_lemma {A B : Set ℂ} (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B) (hAu : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y ≠ 1) (hBu : ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ y ∈ B, dist x y ≠ 1) {u : ℂ} {K : Set ℝ} (hK : K.Finite) (hcollar : ∀ θ : ℝ, (∀ κ ∈ K, ∀ m : ℤ, θ ≠ κ + 2 * π * m) → ∃ s, CollarAt (closure (A ∪ B)) u s θ) (hseed : ∃ (s : Rim) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ), π / 3 < θ₂ - θ₁ ∧ ∀ θ ∈ Icc θ₁ θ₂, CollarAt (closure (A ∪ B)) u s θ) : False

name: collarAt_shadow_outer
doc:
/-- **Outer collars from a cone direction**: a preconnected `R` with `u ∈ closure R` approaching `u` along `β` meets the unit circle about

name: exists_sectorsAt
doc:

arcs have tangents); the sectors between consecutive directions (two tangent arcs bounding a horn), with adjacent sectors of one colour
merged, are the picture. -/

name: exists_woodallMerged
doc:

`P` are joined across a run of sectors of angle `< π` between them (every unit circle through a point of the run near `P`, except those through

name: false_of_four_le_sectors
doc:

doc:
